Package org.apache.hadoop.hdfs.server.federation.store.driver.impl

@Private @Evolving package org.apache.hadoop.hdfs.server.federation.store.driver.impl
Implementations of state store data providers/drivers. Each driver is responsible for maintaining, querying, updating and deleting persistent data records. Data records are defined as subclasses of BaseRecord. Each driver implements the StateStoreDriver interface.

Currently supported drivers:

  • StateStoreFileImpl A file-based data storage backend.
  • StateStoreZooKeeperImpl A zookeeper based data storage backend.
